commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+6' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+5' Ange Postecoglou is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Archie Gray suffers an injury and Will Lankshear (Tottenham) comes on.
90+4' Kenny Tete (Fulham) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
90+3' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bernd Leno intercepts the ball.
90+2' Fulham fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90+1' Harry Wilson (Fulham) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.

90' Poor effort! The corner picks out Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) completely unmarked in the centre of the box. He has time to pick his spot with the header but makes a mess of it, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
90' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
88' Tottenham are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
86' It's time for a substitution. Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) comes on in place of Alex Iwobi.
86' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Timothy Castagne (Fulham) replaces Emile Smith Rowe.
85' Here's the change. Pape Matar Sarr leaves the pitch and Archie Gray (Tottenham) comes on as a substitute.
84' Here is a change. James Maddison is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham).
83' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Tom Cairney (Fulham). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.

82' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Tom Cairney (Fulham), but referee Darren Bond must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
82' Yellow card. Tom Cairney (Fulham) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
79' The Tottenham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
78' It will be a substitution. Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) is ready to enter the pitch as Raul Jimenez walks off.
78' Tottenham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
77' James Maddison (Tottenham) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall.
76' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Alex Iwobi (Fulham). Darren Bond saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
74' James Maddison (Tottenham) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
74' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Tottenham will have a corner.
74' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
73' The current number of shots on goal is 3:6.
72' Darren Bond blows the whistle, Calvin Bassey (Fulham) is penalised for a foul.
71' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
69' James Maddison (Tottenham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
68' A substitution has been made. Timo Werner is replaced by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham).
67' 1 - 1 Goal! Tom Cairney (Fulham) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes inside the right post. It's 1:1.
65' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
62' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Reiss Nelson is replaced by Harry Wilson (Fulham).
62' Substitution. Tom Cairney (Fulham) on for Sasa Lukic.
61' James Maddison (Tottenham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Darren Bond blows his whistle for an infringement.
57' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
57' The attendance for today's match is 61141.
54' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Timo Werner plays it into the box, and Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the roof of the net. 1:0.
54' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Fraser Forster is prepared to thwart his effort.

52' Well-positioned Alex Iwobi (Fulham) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the middle, but Fraser Forster reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
51' Kenny Tete (Fulham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
50' Issa Diop (Fulham) rises above the defence and heads the ball low, into the middle of the goal. The keeper is there waiting and denies him.
49' Fulham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
47' Tottenham are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fulham comes to nothing.
45+2' James Maddison (Tottenham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
45+2' OFF THE POST! James Maddison (Tottenham) fires the ball from the free kick, but it only rattles the left post.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Darren Bond blows his whistle and signals a foul after Sasa Lukic (Fulham) brought his opponent down.
45' Fulham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45' Fulham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat. Raul Jimenez (Fulham) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
42' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the crossbar. Close!
42' A cross from a corner kick by Fulham is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
41' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
41' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
39' Tottenham fail to score from a corner as Bernd Leno (Fulham) leaps to collect the ball.
39' Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header directed into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop his effort.
38' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
37' Sander Berge (Fulham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Darren Bond no option but to blow his whistle.
36' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Fraser Forster is alert and denies him with a nice save.
33' Tottenham hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
33' Fulham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
32' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
27' Great teamplay by Fulham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
25' The resulting set piece from Tottenham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
25' That was close by Pedro Porro (Tottenham)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
24' The Tottenham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
22' Fulham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
21' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
20' Ball possession – 46:54.
19' The ball is cleared after Pedro Porro (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
16' Wonderful movement by Fulham. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
13' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
13' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) will deliver the corner kick.
12' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
11' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
10' Timo Werner (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
8' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Fulham.
7' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) takes the corner with a short pass.

7' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders.
6' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) jumps into a tackle and Darren Bond signals a foul.
6' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

6' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
5' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
3' Timo Werner (Tottenham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

1' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Bernd Leno pulls off a brilliant save.
1' Fulham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
